name: 17870 · Selinsgrove, PA
findings: ZIP 17870 (Selinsgrove) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17870 (Selinsgrove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17870 (Selinsgrove) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
